topic: What happens when you open a website
title: 🌐 What Happens When You Open a Website?
description: 🌐 Ever wonder what happens in the split second after you type a URL? #shorts #internet #explained
narration: Every time you type a website address, something incredible happens in less than a second. Your browser does not actually know where that website lives. So it asks a special server called a DNS server, which works like a phone book for the internet. It translates the name you typed into a number address. Your request then travels through cables, sometimes under the ocean, to reach the server that holds the website. That server reads your request and sends back all the pieces. Your browser collects all those pieces and assembles them into the page you see. All of this happens in about 200 milliseconds. So the next time a website loads instantly, remember: your request just traveled halfway around the world and back.
